evidence.positive: Against the running build (demo-demo tenant, admin API): case 51077 on p-gastroduodenal with no antibiotics, PROCEDURE_START via /api/admin/events/category-event -> /api/admin/rule/evaluations/fired returned one a-incomplete-antibiotic-pathway record with details.PATHWAY_STATUS=NONE_GIVEN and app log 'Rule evaluated: a-incomplete-antibiotic-pathway -> true'. Case 93990 on p-colorectal with a 2000 mg cefazolin IV bolus only -> one firing with PATHWAY_STATUS=PARTIALLY_GIVEN and PARTIALLY_GIVEN_GROUPS=[{missingMeds:[MetroNIDAZOLE], medsAdministered:[CeFAZolin]}]. Persisted prompt JSON in rule_fired_results: NONE_GIVEN title 'Administer CeFAZolin', description 'Patient received no antibiotics. Prior to incision for Gastroduodenal procedure, recommend CeFAZolin'; PARTIALLY_GIVEN title 'Administer MetroNIDAZOLE', description 'Patient received CeFAZolin. For Colorectal procedure, recommend MetroNIDAZOLE in addition to CeFAZolin'. A jsonb field-by-field diff of these prompts against prompts produced by the pre-fix a-known-procedure-no-antibiotic / a-known-procedure-missing-antibiotic classes for the same scenarios differed only in ruleIdentifier and createdDate, so titles, descriptions, accept/reject text and rejection reasons are unchanged. Valkey holds one lockout key per case: rule/a-incomplete-antibiotic-pathway/patient/<id>/operation/<id>/recentlyFired.
evidence.negative: Case 37954 on p-colorectal with both cefazolin 2000 mg and metronidazole IV 500 mg given, then PROCEDURE_START -> zero fired records and /api/admin/rule/evaluations/not-fired explanation 'Procedure candidates were given.' (log: 'Rule evaluated: a-incomplete-antibiotic-pathway -> false Procedure candidates were given.'). Shared lockout (the one intended behaviour change): case 14073 on p-colorectal, PROCEDURE_START with nothing given fired NONE_GIVEN; then a cefazolin bolus was added and a second PROCEDURE_START sent -> fired count stayed at 1 (still NONE_GIVEN only), not-fired explanation 'Already fired for this case.' Repeated after the class restore on case 37842 with the same result.
evidence.red_check: Compiled the parent commit's KnownProcedureNoAntibioticRule and StartProcedureMissingAntibioticRule (65448ac4f, lombok @Slf4j replaced by an explicit slf4j logger) inside the container with javac against /app/classes:/app/libs/*, backed up the three shipped IncompleteAntibioticPathwayRule*.class files with md5sums, removed them from /app/classes, dropped the two pre-fix classes in, and restarted the container (shipped EventBasedRuleEngine kept, since the pre-fix engine ignore-listed the missing-antibiotic rule). Boot logged 'Created feature flag for rule: a-known-procedure-missing-antibiotic' and '...a-known-procedure-no-antibiotic'. Re-ran the lockout scenario on case 19435: first PROCEDURE_START fired a-known-procedure-no-antibiotic; after a cefazolin bolus the second PROCEDURE_START fired a-known-procedure-missing-antibiotic as a second alert on the same case (fired count 1 under each old rule ID, log 'Rule evaluated: a-known-procedure-missing-antibiotic -> true null', two Valkey lockout keys for the operation) - the pre-merge double alert the ticket removes, seen red. Reverted: removed the pre-fix classes, copied the backups back, md5sum -c reported OK for all three files, restarted, boot showed no old-rule flag creation, and the lockout scenario on case 37842 abstained again with 'Already fired for this case.'

caveats: The PARTIALLY_GIVEN branch re-enables alerting that OR-2949 (PR #4607, merged immediately before this PR) had switched off by ignore-listing a-known-procedure-missing-antibiotic in EventBasedRuleEngine; PR #4582 deliberately dropped that ignore entry, so relative to the prior main the partial-dose alert returns for clinicians. Confirm that is intended before deploy.

Acceptance criterion 'pre-deploy flag and config check is done for MGB and Mayo prod' and the Metabase card / hand-applied prod view updates cannot be verified from this instance; nothing on the ticket records them as done.
Alert text was verified from the persisted prompt JSON and compared to the pre-fix rules' output; the alert was not rendered in the browser UI.

Only the demo-demo tenant was exercised, with acuity-less pathways (p-gastroduodenal, p-colorectal); the acuity-labelled display paths (USE_CLASSIFICATION_DISPLAY) and the unmapped/unqualified-procedure abstains were not driven at runtime.

The red check ran the two pre-fix rule classes under the shipped engine class, because the actual parent commit's engine ignore-listed the missing-antibiotic rule and would not have produced the double alert.

jira_comment:
Verdict: deploy-ready.

Positive: With nothing given, PROCEDURE_START fired the merged rule with PATHWAY_STATUS NONE_GIVEN, and with cefazolin alone on a colorectal case it fired PARTIALLY_GIVEN naming metronidazole as missing, with prompt text identical to the retired rules.
Negative: With cefazolin plus metronidazole given the rule abstained with 'Procedure candidates were given.', and after a NONE_GIVEN firing a partial dose plus a second PROCEDURE_START abstained with 'Already fired for this case.'
Red check: Swapping the pre-fix rule classes into the running container made the second PROCEDURE_START fire a-known-procedure-missing-antibiotic as a second alert on the same case, and restoring the shipped classes brought back the single-alert behaviour.

Automation: Unit coverage is thorough and PABX-019 covers NONE_GIVEN end to end; supplemental PABX tests for the PARTIALLY_GIVEN firing and the shared lockout are proposed.
